author: Unity
description:
Want to build proximity voice chat into your Unity game? Join Anthony Tešija from Discord and Joy Horvath from Unity as they break down exactly how to do it using the Discord Social SDK. In this video, they’ll give an overview of how it works and dive into the important pieces of code required to make the connection work.

🔗 Ready to build it yourself? Check out Discord’s official guide to adding proximity voice chat in Unity: https://on.unity.com/DiscordSDK
